_provenance: curated 2026-08-28; pins resolved via git ls-remote same day; the label vocabulary is closed — extend it here first, never ad hoc in an experiment
purpose: Reusable label set of projects for parser-construct census experiments (operator order 2026-08-28). The unit of observation downstream is the TypeScript declaration; these labels are the sampling strata every experiment reuses, so per-construct statistics stay comparable across runs and instruments.

labelVocabulary.clean-effect: library-authored Effect source in the canonical register (src/ of the Effect monorepo packages)
labelVocabulary.wild-effect: Effect-consuming code NOT held to the canonical register: monorepo tests, internals, app code (aliased imports, submodule imports, host interleavings are the norm here)
labelVocabulary.estate: foldlab-authored TypeScript, including generated backends — the code our own gates already hold byte-identical
labelVocabulary.generated: machine-emitted TypeScript (backend materializer output); recognition should be total here — any refusal is a finding
labelVocabulary.dts-only: pure declaration syntax (.d.ts), no statement bodies — exercises the type-level grammar surface including variance annotations
labelVocabulary.non-effect-baseline: TypeScript with no Effect dependency — the control stratum; spine rules must fire at ~zero here or the recognizer is hallucinating
labelVocabulary.declaration-heavy: unusually high ratio of type-level declarations to executable statements
labelVocabulary.variance-annotations: known to contain `in`/`out` type-parameter variance — the pinned grammar's held defect (D1 evidence stratum)
labelVocabulary.harness: in-house experiment tooling; parsed as corpus AND used as instrument plumbing

slices.variance-annotations: the Effect schema surface named in the twin receipt (Filter/FilterGroup) and dsl-proposal §6

projects.note: primary corpus; the DSL proposal's §4b wild samples are all cited from this checkout at this pin

projects.pin: tracked by the estate's own history
projects.note: generated slices carry the 'generated' label: recognition must be total there, refusals are findings
control stratum: large, idiomatic, zero Effect; also the grammar's hardest natural workout

slices.dts-only: types/** (stratified random sample of packages; record the sampled package list per run)

projects.note: declaration-only stratum; sample by package, never by file, and commit the sampled package list with the run

slices.wild-effect: content/** code snippets and app src/** — Effect as consumers actually write it

projects.note: app-register Effect: the register the acquisition loop (R15) ultimately has to meet
